newsitem.title: USA: NYC Council committee approves shipboard gaming.
newsitem.headline: NYC Council committee approves shipboard gaming.

text.p: A New York City Council committee on Tuesday approved legislation that will create a local gaming commission to oversee shipboard gambling.
The measure, proposed by New York City Mayor Rudolph Giuliani and approved by the Council Finance Committee, was slated to go before the full council for a vote on June 25.
The chairman of the Finance Committee, Herbert Berman, stressed that the legislation did not legitimize gambling, but only regulated a business that has sprung up in recent months.

The city was not expected to get additional revenues as a result of the bill. But city officials have previously said they expected to tax the profits of shipboard gambling cruises, including Bay Cruises, which sails from Sheephead's Bay in Brooklyn.
